Madras HC Upholds FCRA Rejection for Trust, Contrasts Religions

The Madras High Court upheld the rejection of the Kanzeon Public Charitable Trust's application for registration under the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act, 2010 (FCRA). The court observed that Hinduism is inclusive, while Abrahamic religions are inherently exclusive. It stated that organizations seeking foreign contributions must correctly disclose their religious character and activities, warning against foreign-funded conversion. The High Court's decision was reported by The Statesman, The Commune, and OpIndia.
